title: CompiledBundle manifest
description: Describes a compiled rule bundle: what is in it, and how to verify that what was downloaded is what was published.

bundle_version.description: Calendar version, YYYY.MM.n. Rules track the law rather than the software, so bundles are dated rather than semantically versioned. Derived by the build from the bundle's content alone since 2026-10-12 (until then it was the constant 2026.07.1 whatever the rules held): 0000.00.n, where 0000.00 says this is not a dated release and n is the first 24 bits of the bundle's content digest as a decimal number, so it is NOT a sequence. A rebuild of the same rules keeps the version and any change to a listed file gives another; never the build time, because carry-forward holds every carried verdict to this value. BUNDLE_VERSION in the build's environment sets a dated label explicitly, for a release.

packs.description: Rule packs included in this bundle.

rules.description: Number of rules the pack contributes.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdictions the pack covers: "EU" or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.

files.description: Bundle file name -> sha256 digest. Lets a client verify each file it loads.

engine_pins.description: Engine name -> pinned version. Detector results depend on the engine, so reproducing a scan means reproducing the engine too.

signature.description: The string "unsigned" while bundles ship unsigned: an explicit marker, so an unsigned bundle is never read as one whose signature went missing. `null` is what bundles built before 2026-10-12 carry, and means the same as "unsigned".

changelog_url.description: Where to read what changed in this bundle, and why.
